cards.ex: I managed to talk him into lowering the price a little bit.
cards.exUz: Men uni narxni biroz pasaytirishga ko'ndirishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir biror narsaga rozi qilishga urinmoq, gap bilan ishontirmoq.

cards.ex: It's important to find common ground to build a successful partnership.
cards.exUz: Muvaffaqiyatli hamkorlikni qurish uchun umumiy til topish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni hal qilish uchun umumiy fikrga kelishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's known for driving a hard bargain, so be prepared to negotiate.
cards.exUz: U qattiq savdolashishi bilan tanilgan, shuning uchun muzokaraga tayyor bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Savdolashuvda juda qattiq turmoq va o'z foydasini ko'zlamoq.

cards.ex: Using silence can be a powerful negotiating tactic.
cards.exUz: Sukutdan foydalanish kuchli muzokara usuli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda maqsadga erishish uchun ishlatiladigan strategiya yoki usul.

cards.ex: A little humor can help break the ice at the start of a negotiation.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar boshida biroz hazil muzni eritishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarni boshlash uchun noqulaylikni yo'qotishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: By threatening to pull out, they raised the stakes significantly.
cards.exUz: Chiqib ketish bilan tahdid qilib, ular xavfni sezilarli darajada oshirdilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning ahamiyatini yoki xavfini oshirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: If you play your cards right, you might get a better deal.
cards.exUz: Agar to'g'ri harakat qilsangiz, yaxshiroq kelishuvga erishishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatdan to'g'ri foydalanib, maqsadga erishishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The payment terms became a major sticking point in the contract negotiations.
cards.exUz: To'lov shartlari shartnoma bo'yicha muzokaralarda asosiy kelishmovchilik nuqtasiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda kelishish qiyin bo'lgan masala yoki nuqta.

cards.ex: He tried to smooth things over after the argument, but it was too late.
cards.exUz: U bahsdan keyin vaziyatni yumshatishga harakat qildi, lekin kech edi.
cards.uzDef: Nizoni yoki muammoni hal qilishga harakat qilib, vaziyatni yaxshilamoq.

cards.ex: If neither side compromises, it'll be a lose-lose situation for everyone involved.
cards.exUz: Agar hech bir tomon murosaga kelmasa, bu barcha ishtirokchilar uchun yutqazish holati bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Hech kim yutmaydigan va barcha tomonlar zarar ko'radigan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Let's talk through the details and see if we can find a solution.
cards.exUz: Keling, tafsilotlarni muhokama qilaylik va yechim topa olamizmi.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammoni yoki vaziyatni batafsil muhokama qilish.

cards.ex: We don't have much room for maneuver on the price, but we can offer other benefits.
cards.exUz: Narx bo'yicha harakat qilish uchun unchalik imkoniyatimiz yo'q, lekin biz boshqa imtiyozlarni taklif qilishimiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralarda o'zgarishlar qilish yoki kelishuvga erishish uchun imkoniyat.

cards.ex: The two companies are at loggerheads over the intellectual property rights.
cards.exUz: Ikki kompaniya intellektual mulk huquqlari bo'yicha kelishmovchilikda.
cards.uzDef: Biror masala bo'yicha qattiq kelishmovchilikda bo'lish.

cards.ex: To secure the deal, they went the extra mile and offered additional services.
cards.exUz: Kelishuvni ta'minlash uchun ular qo'shimcha harakat qildilar va qo'shimcha xizmatlar taklif qildilar.
cards.uzDef: Oddiyidan ko'ra ko'proq harakat qilish, ko'proq narsa taklif qilish.

cards.ex: Even though they pressured her, she stuck to her guns and refused to compromise.
cards.exUz: Ular uni bosim o'tkazgan bo'lsalar ham, u o'z fikrida qat'iy turdi va murosaga kelishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni qat'iy himoya qilish, o'z pozitsiyangizdan chekinmaslik.

cards.ex: Their proposal was a non-starter from the beginning, we never would have agreed.
cards.exUz: Ularning taklifi boshidan boshlanmaydigan narsa edi, biz hech qachon rozi bo'lmas edik.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday natija bermaydigan, amalga oshmaydigan taklif yoki g'oya.

cards.ex: Let's lay our cards on the table and see if we can reach an agreement.
cards.exUz: Keling, kartalarimizni stolga qo'yaylik va kelishuvga erisha olamizmi.
cards.term: lay your cards on the table
cards.uzDef: Barcha fikrlaringizni va niyatlaringizni yashirmasdan, ochiqchasiga aytish.

cards.ex: We're willing to meet you halfway if you can improve the delivery time.
cards.exUz: Agar siz yetkazib berish vaqtini yaxshilasangiz, biz siz bilan yarim yo'lda uchrashishga tayyormiz.
cards.uzDef: Murosaga kelish uchun, har ikki tomon o'z pozitsiyasidan biroz chekinishi.

cards.ex: The media is putting a lot of pressure on the government to act.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari hukumatni harakat qilishga katta bosim o'tkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir biror narsani qilishga majburlashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We will leave no stone unturned to find a solution to this crisis.
cards.exUz: Biz bu inqirozga yechim topish uchun barcha imkoniyatni ishga solamiz.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish uchun barcha imkoniyatlardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: They offered a quid pro quo: they'd support our project if we supported theirs.
cards.exUz: Ular evaziga evaz taklif qilishdi: agar biz ularnikini qo'llab-quvvatlasak, ular bizning loyihamizni qo'llab-quvvatlaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa evaziga boshqa narsani berish yoki olish, almashuv.

cards.ex: The negotiations reached an impasse, and no progress was made.
cards.exUz: Muzokaralar berk ko'chaga kirdi va hech qanday natijaga erishilmadi.
cards.uzDef: Muzokaralar davom etmaydigan, yechim topilmaydigan holatga kelish.

cards.ex: The deal created a win-win situation for both companies.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv har ikki kompaniya uchun yutuqli vaziyatni yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Har ikki tomon uchun ham foydali va muvaffaqiyatli bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: We have several new initiatives in the pipeline that we're excited about.
cards.exUz: Bizda rejalashtirilayotgan bir nechta yangi tashabbuslar bor, biz bundan xursandmiz.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda rejalashtirilayotgan yoki ishlab chiqilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: Both countries need to be on equal footing before any meaningful dialogue can begin.
cards.exUz: Har qanday mazmunli muloqot boshlanishidan oldin ikkala davlat ham teng sharoitlarda bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Teng huquqlar va imkoniyatlarga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: We decided to test the waters before making a formal offer.
cards.exUz: Rasmiy taklif berishdan oldin sinab ko'rishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning imkoniyatini yoki qabul qilinishini oldindan sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: To sweeten the pot, they offered a bonus payment.
cards.exUz: Taklifni yaxshilash uchun ular bonus to'lovini taklif qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Taklifni yanada jozibali qilish uchun qo'shimcha imtiyozlar berish.

cards.ex: The confidentiality clause was a deal breaker for them.
cards.exUz: Maxfiylik bandi ular uchun kelishuv buzuvchi edi.
cards.uzDef: Kelishuvni imkonsiz qiladigan omil yoki shart.

cards.ex: The agreement must be followed to the letter to avoid any misunderstandings.
cards.exUz: Har qanday tushunmovchilikning oldini olish uchun kelishuvga harfma-harf rioya qilish kerak.
cards.uzDef: So'zma-so'z, aniq va to'liq bajarish.

cards.ex: We need to iron out our differences before we can move forward.
cards.exUz: Oldinga siljishimizdan oldin farqlarimizni bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kelishmovchiliklarni muhokama qilib, ularni hal qilishga harakat qilish.
